title: NIST WebBook: Calcium is Ca, molecular weight 40.078 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Calcium as Ca, molecular weight 40.078 amu, CAS 7440-70-2.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Calcium, CAS Registry Number 7440-70-2, lists molecular formula Ca and molecular weight 40.078 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 39.96259098 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/Ca. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
